name: Val Town Free
free_limit: Val Town Free: 100,000 val runs/day, unlimited public vals, up to 2,500 vals and cron schedules no more frequently than every 15 minutes
watch_out: Free vals are public (no private vals), each run has a one-minute wall-clock timeout and logs are retained for three days. Custom domains, external email recipients, 1-minute cron schedules and longer runtimes require paid Pro; ongoing Free is not a short-term trial.
